package_info.why_malicious: The entire package is a trojanized version of the legitimate Tor Browser, distributed via spam and Pastebin, designed to steal cryptocurrency from users by intercepting or exfiltrating wallet credentials and transaction data.

execution_context.trigger: runtime (when user launches the trojanized Tor Browser)
execution_context.file_location: Injected into the main Tor Browser executable or bundled scripts

malicious_snippets.code_language: javascript (or C++/Python, depending on Tor Browser internals)
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code monitors for cryptocurrency wallet activity, intercepts wallet credentials or transaction data, and exfiltrates this information to an attacker-controlled server, resulting in theft of cryptocurrency.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Legitimate browsers do not monitor for or exfiltrate cryptocurrency wallet credentials. The presence of code that specifically targets wallet activity and sends data to external servers is a strong indicator of malicious intent.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: A normal Tor Browser build should not contain any code that accesses or exfiltrates user wallet data. The malicious version violates user trust and privacy.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Security tools may monitor wallet activity for user protection, but never exfiltrate credentials.
key_indicators: Code that hooks or monitors for wallet-related activity
Exfiltration of sensitive data (wallet credentials, transaction info)

attack_chain.action: Victim is lured to download the trojanized Tor Browser via spam or Pastebin links.
Victim installs and launches the trojanized Tor Browser.
Malicious code monitors for cryptocurrency wallet activity and intercepts credentials or transaction data.
Stolen wallet credentials and transaction data are sent to attacker-controlled servers.

behavioral_signatures: Browser process making unexpected outbound connections to non-Tor, non-update servers
Access to local wallet files or clipboard monitoring for wallet addresses
Injection or modification of browser scripts to intercept sensitive data
file_indicators: Tor Browser executables or installers with mismatched digital signatures
Presence of additional scripts or binaries not found in official Tor Browser releases
network_indicators: Outbound connections to attacker-controlled C2 domains/IPs (not part of Tor network)
Unusual POST requests containing wallet or credential data
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for Tor Browser installations that do not match official hashes or signatures, detect browser processes accessing wallet files or clipboard, and alert on outbound network connections from browser processes to suspicious domains or IPs. Use behavioral analysis to flag browsers that attempt to exfiltrate sensitive data.
